Name: Become Ethereal
Author: Jishuna
Description:
Lets you walk through various objects in the game, By default, you can only walk through lamps and braziers, but this can be changed in the configuration file allowing you to walk through chests, machines, rocks, and more.

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.

[/list]
